title: jams engine input script, format v2

$schema.description: The input-script JSON Schema this file follows.

scene.description: The scene this script was written for; a run against another scene is refused.

at.description: Play from here instead of the game's spawn, cast along the game's spawn direction (gravity by default) onto the first surface it meets; refused inside a solid.

prefixItems.description: y in world metres; y is down.

timeOffsetMs.description: Advance time-driven entities (followers) by this much before tick 0.

seed.description: Seeds the game's `ctx.random` for the run; omitted, the default for the game and scene, the same every run.

players.description: The seats the script drives, 1 to 8; default the run's: the project input map's `players.max`, else the game's `input.players.max`, else 1.

maxTicks.description: The run ends as `timeout` after this many ticks (default 1800, 30 s).

steps.description: Seat 0's steps, played in order from tick 0; a script has these or `tracks`.

tracks.description: One track of steps per seat, all run at once from tick 0; or `steps`.

description: A headless playtest: steps of held actions, analog values, pointer moves and seat changes at 60 ticks a second, as `steps` for seat 0 or as `tracks`, one per seat, run at once. The run ends when the game's outcome hook decides, when every track's steps ran out (`script-end`), at `maxTicks` (`timeout`), or `stuck` (a movement action held with the focus moving under 0.04 m in 120 ticks).

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

set.description: Axis values and vector pairs held beside the actions.

for.description: Run for this many ticks (60 a second).

anyOf.description: Hold actions, and with `set` analog values, for a fixed number of ticks.

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

set.description: Axis values and vector pairs held beside the actions.

forMs.description: Run for this many milliseconds, rounded to whole 60 Hz ticks (at least one).

anyOf.description: Hold actions, and with `set` analog values, for a duration in milliseconds.

hold.description: Every action held during the step; what the step before held and this one doesn't is released when it starts. Empty holds nothing.

set.description: Axis values and vector pairs held beside the actions.

max.description: Give up waiting after this many ticks and go on to the next step (default 600).

anyOf.description: Hold actions, and with `set` analog values, until a condition holds, capped by `max` ticks.

for.description: Run for this many ticks (60 a second).

anyOf.description: Hold analog values for a fixed number of ticks.

forMs.description: Run for this many milliseconds, rounded to whole 60 Hz ticks (at least one).

anyOf.description: Hold analog values for a duration in milliseconds.

max.description: Give up waiting after this many ticks and go on to the next step (default 600).

anyOf.description: Hold analog values until a condition holds, capped by `max` ticks.
Drive the pointer for one slot.

for.description: Run for this many ticks (60 a second).

anyOf.description: Drive the pointer for a fixed number of ticks.

forMs.description: Run for this many milliseconds, rounded to whole 60 Hz ticks (at least one).

anyOf.description: Drive the pointer for a duration in milliseconds.

max.description: Give up waiting after this many ticks and go on to the next step (default 600).

anyOf.description: Drive the pointer until a condition holds, capped by `max` ticks.

press.description: The action or actions to press.

anyOf.description: Press for one tick: the actions go down at the step's tick and up at the next. Nothing else is held.

wait.description: Hold nothing for this many ticks.

anyOf.description: Release everything for a number of ticks.

command.description: A command name; this registry's game declares none.

args.description: The command's arguments, checked by its `args` schema; omit for none.

anyOf.description: Send a command from the track's seat for one slot, still holding what the hold step before it held (nothing after a press or wait). It wakes a turns or event game.

elapse.description: Milliseconds away, sent as `@elapsed`; this game has no `time.catchUp`, so it refuses the step.

anyOf.description: Report wall time away for one slot, as `@elapsed`, still holding what the hold step before it held (nothing after a press or wait). It wakes every game.

join.description: The device that takes the track's seat.

anyOf.description: A device joins the track's seat, for one slot; it leaves the seat it held before.

leave.description: The device the track's seat gives up.

anyOf.description: The track's seat gives up a device, for one slot.

Step.description: One step: `hold` (with `set` beside it or not) or `set`, with exactly one of `for`, `forMs` or `until`; `pointer`, alone for one slot or with one of them; `press`; `wait`; `command`; `elapse`; `join`; or `leave`.

Action.description: An action name; this registry has no game, so it declares none.

AnalogSet.description: Axis values and vector pairs held for the step, by action; this game declares no axis or vector actions.

tick.description: Holds once this absolute tick (from 0) is reached or passed.

scene.description: Holds once the main scene is this one (its asset id), after a flow request the run followed.

Until.description: Ends the step on the first tick where every key holds (AND), checked after each tick, so the step runs at least one tick. Predicates: event, tick, exists, count, scene, persist.

anyOf.description: An event type, e.g. `sensor:enter`.

entityId.description: The entity the event must name, e.g. the sensor for `sensor:enter`.

other.description: The other entity it must name, e.g. what entered the sensor.

anyOf.description: An event type with the entity ids it must name.

EventMatch.description: Holds on a tick that raised a matching event.

anyOf.description: An entity id; holds while it exists and is enabled.

enabled.description: False holds while the entity exists, enabled or not.

anyOf.description: An entity id, and whether a disabled entity counts.

ExistsMatch.description: Holds while an entity exists and is enabled, spawned ids (`boss#1`) included; it fails once the entity is destroyed.

type.description: Only entities of this type, or of any of these.

enabled.description: Default true: only enabled entities; false counts disabled ones too.

min.description: Holds when at least this many match.

max.description: Holds when at most this many match.

eq.description: Holds when exactly this many match.

CountMatch.description: Holds while the number of entities matching the selector (type, tag, enabled) keeps the bounds: `min`, `max` (both for a range) or `eq`.

EntityType.description: An entity type: solid, sensor, marker, prop, follower, decor, nav, note.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer into the persistent value, e.g. "/coins"; "" is the whole value.

eq.description: Holds while the value there equals this, key order aside.

gte.description: Holds while the value there is a number at least this.

lte.description: Holds while the value there is a number at most this.

PersistMatch.description: Holds while the persistent value (`ctx.persist`) at `pointer` keeps every bound given; a pointer naming nothing doesn't hold.

prefixItems.description: y in world metres; y is down.

at.description: Where the pointer is when the step starts, in world metres.

press.description: A button that goes down when the step starts and stays down until a release.

release.description: A button that lets go when the step ends.

drag.description: Moves the pointer linearly from `at` to here over the step's length, reaching it on the step's last slot.

prefixItems.description: y in world metres; y is down.

ScriptPointer.description: The seat's pointer: its position, a button pressed or released, and a drag.

Device.description: A device: `keyboard`, `pointer`, `touch` or `pad:<n>`, n in connection order.

player.description: The seat these steps drive, from 0.

steps.description: The seat's steps, played in order from tick 0.

Track.description: One seat's steps; every track runs at once from tick 0, each with its own `until`s.
